subtitle: Thursday, 27 August 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Commission endorses Greece's €4.8 billion Social Climate Plan to support vulnerable households, transport users and micro-enterprises in the clean transition
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 27 Aug 2026 Today, the European Commission adopted Greece's Social Climate Plan. It is the fifth and largest national plan adopted under the Social Climate Fund so far, which will use the revenues from emission allowances to advance the clean transition and support vulnerable consumers and enterprises.
